papers.title_en: QTOP: Scaling Humanoid Motion Tracking with Quantile Critics
papers.authors: Markus Peschl, Dana Kianfar, Daniel Dijkman
papers.evidence: 基于分布式评论家的人形运动跟踪强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身控制依赖强化学习运动跟踪，但泛化到未见动作需联合扩展数千GPU与数据小时，且多样动作带来学习干扰，使训练呈计算瓶颈。作者提出QTOP，用状态-参考对条件下的分布优势估计提升样本效率。在仿真与真实场景、多数据集上，QTOP较同策略与异策略基线最高提升10%，并给出缩放规律。该工作为高保真运动跟踪的可扩展训练提供了方法及经验规律。
papers.abstract_en: Learning human motion tracking policies through reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a core capability that underpins a majority of recent progress in humanoid whole-body control. However, achieving generalization to unseen motions at high fidelity requires jointly scaling training to thousands of GPU and dataset hours. This work hypothesizes that motion tracking is inherently compute-bound because training on a diverse set of motions introduces learning interference, similar to multi-task RL. To tackle this, we propose Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP), which improves sample efficiency by introducing a distributional advantage estimate conditioned on state and reference pairs. QTOP outperforms on and off-policy RL baselines both in simulation and real-world tracking scenarios on multiple datasets by up to 10\%. Furthermore, we establish a scaling law for QTOP and find that, aside from scaling predictably, dataset size has minimal impact on performance for moderately sized GPU hour regimes.

papers.title_en: Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations
papers.authors: Thomas Woehrle, Linus Ericsson, Henry Gouk, Elliot J. Crowley
papers.evidence: 基于基础操作的表达性神经架构搜索空间
papers.tldr: 现有NAS搜索空间虽追求表达力，但多面向图像分类，自回归序列建模仍缺乏能从基础操作构造并搜索序列模型的表达性空间。本文扩展einspace，提出einspaceAR，用基础操作表示自回归模型并降低结构归纳偏置。实验表明该空间可从零搜索到有能力的自回归序列模型。这为NAS工具箱补充了自回归搜索能力，也为其他表达性空间集成自回归建模提供蓝图。
papers.abstract_en: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.

papers.title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Hard Constraints: Policy Gradient Methods with Intersample Guarantees
papers.authors: Vipul K. Sharma, S. Sivaranjani
papers.evidence: 带控制屏障函数硬安全约束的策略梯度强化学习
papers.tldr: 针对非线性采样数据系统的硬约束安全强化学习，现有策略梯度方法难以保证采样间隔内安全。作者将随机策略支撑集截断到依赖采样周期的安全控制集，提出无模型策略梯度算法并给出采样周期充分条件。理论上证明有限时间收敛、样本复杂度与梯度支配下的全局最优性，并保证任意采样动作在整个采样区间安全。最后在四旋翼导航环境中验证间隔内安全保证，为硬约束安全强化学习提供可证明框架。
papers.abstract_en: We develop a policy-gradient (PG) reinforcement learning (RL) framework with hard inter-sample control barrier function (CBF)-based safety constraints for nonlinear sampled-data systems. We first design a class of stochastic policies with support truncated to sampling-period-dependent safe control sets, that guarantee safety-by-construction at sampling instants. We then propose a model-free PG algorithm that searches over the class of safe-by-design policies and establish sufficient conditions on sampling-period such that any action sampled from safe control sets remains safe throughout the sampling interval, providing inter-sample guarantees. We further establish finite-time convergence and sample complexity guarantees for the proposed PG algorithm and characterize its global optimality under gradient dominance. Finally, we illustrate inter-sample safety guarantees on a safe quadrotor navigation environment.

papers.title_en: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
papers.authors: Michael Schroeder
papers.evidence: EfficientNet紧凑骨干中的深度可分离卷积与注意力插入
papers.tldr: 紧凑卷积骨干参数高效，但全局注意力该插在哪、重复块能否共享权重仍不明确。本文在EfficientNet-B0上做受控实验，将零门控残差自注意力适配器插入P3/P4/P5，并评估MBConv重复块的循环权重共享。结果显示注意力适配器达74.02%，比匹配对照高0.954个百分点，且注意力幅度随语义深度上升；Stage 6交替共享两模板减参10.9%，仅降1.84个百分点。研究为混合视觉骨干中全局上下文与权重共享的位置选择提供了实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 control by +0.954 percentage points (73.88% vs. 72.92%) across an 88-epoch stateless replay schedule, with learned attention amplitude rising monotonically with semantic depth (27.2% at P3 -> 45.4% at P4 -> 66.3% at P5). Second, we evaluate recurrent weight sharing across repeated MBConv blocks with pass-specific BatchNorm statistics (+1,536 parameters per pass). While post-hoc kernel averaging degrades accuracy to 17.03% and single-template stage tying (-27.6% parameters) plateaus at 66.10%, alternating two shared block templates ([B1, A, B, A]) in Stage 6 cuts total model parameters by 10.9% (582K weights) and recovers by +10.82 points in a single epoch to 70.92% (-1.84 points vs. unshared control).

papers.title_en: ReLoco: Unified Humanoid Locomotion and Fall Recovery via Behavior-Conditioned Motion Priors
papers.authors: Lequn Fu, Yufeng Hu, Yijun Zhong, Jie Zhang, Xiao Li, Lingxiang Ji, Zhiyuan Xu, Jian Tang, Shiqi Li
papers.evidence: 利用运动先元的强化学习人形机器人行走与跌倒恢复策略
papers.tldr: 人形机器人跌倒后需恢复并继续执行指令，但直立行走与地面起身所需监督差异显著。ReLoco以行为条件对抗运动先验统一学习：按姿态选择专家池，并条件化共享判别器的双行为输出。训练结合任务奖励、共享正则、临时辅助与仿真细化参考。完整策略起身成功率96.80%、推力恢复96.96%，躯干平面速度RMSE 0.1266 m/s，较单输出变体低14.7%，并已在天工3.0部署验证。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots must recover from falls and resume commanded motion to sustain locomotion. Learning these behaviors in one policy requires supervision that accommodates both upright movement and ground-contact recovery. We present ReLoco, a framework that uses behavior-conditioned adversarial motion priors to learn locomotion, get-up from arbitrary fallen postures, and command resumption within one proprioceptive policy. During training, robot posture selects the expert pool and conditions a shared discriminator with two behavior-specific outputs. Task rewards and shared regularization support command tracking and recovery, while temporary assistance facilitates exploration. A simulation-based refinement stage supplies robot-executed motion references for this supervision. Ablations examine conditional supervision, output separation, and reference quality under matched settings. At a common training iteration, the full policy achieves $96.80\%$ independent get-up success and $96.96\%$ push-recovery success, including command resumption. Its torso planar velocity root-mean-square error is $0.1266$~m/s, $14.7\%$ lower than the conditional single-output variant, with similar joint-angle discrepancy measured by dynamic time warping. Deployment on the 64.5-kg Tiangong~3.0 humanoid demonstrates walking, running, get-up, and locomotion resumption after falls using one proprioceptive actor, without controller switching or on-robot policy fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: ECHO: In-Context Behavior foundation model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.authors: Xingyi Wang, Bin Li, Jiyuan Shi, Chenyun Zhang, Weiji Xie, Xiangyu Miao, Junsong Wu, Wei Song, Shiqiang Zhu, Chenjia Bai
papers.evidence: 结合大规模并行强化学习的人形机器人全身控制基础模型
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型虽能通过大规模运动模仿获得多样技能，但难以针对不同物理条件精确执行。ECHO提出上下文行为基础模型，用混合退火采样建立行为先验，并从交互历史学习动态表示以残差修正冻结策略。实验显示其在多样运动与物理条件下优于基线，并在Unitree G1上实现极端杂技、地形交互及负载自适应。该工作将通用行为与动态特定执行解耦，实现无需测试时参数更新的在线适应。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) acquire diverse skills through large-scale motion imitation and massively parallel reinforcement learning, yet broad behavioral capability does not ensure precise execution across physical conditions. Without distinguishing the underlying dynamics, policies may favor conservative compromises over environment-specific precision. We introduce ECHO, an in-context BFM that turns interaction experience into environment-specific control, separating general behavioral capability from dynamics-specific execution. Mixed and Annealed Sampling first establishes a behavior prior in a single pretraining stage by balancing targeted practice with broad motion coverage. Building on this prior, Context Representation and Residual Adaptation learns structured dynamics representations from interaction histories to guide residual corrections to the frozen prior, enabling adaptation without test-time parameter updates. Extensive experiments show that ECHO outperforms all baseline methods across diverse motions and physical conditions. Moreover, deployment on the Unitree G1 demonstrates whole-body teleoperation spanning extreme acrobatics and terrain interaction, alongside payload adaptation in manipulation and whole-body control. Page is available at https://mwondering.github.io/echo-bfm/

papers.title_en: Learning Control-Relevant Koopman Representations from Input-Output Trajectories
papers.authors: Maria Bartzioka, Mohammad Khosravi
papers.evidence: 从输入输出轨迹学习控制相关的Koopman表示
papers.tldr: 预测精度高并不等于Koopman表示适合输出反馈控制。本文仅用输入输出轨迹学习控制相关表示：因果编码器由有限窗口构造提升状态，积分回归辨识加性提升模型，并区分可观测性、输入映射兼容性、可控性与数据信息性。理论上量化输入映射失配，将迭代李括号与提升实现的可控子空间关联，并优化协方差归一化有限时域可观测性准则。精确基准显示编码器初始化决定能否恢复解析提升；Duffing实验表明提升可观测性未改善观测器估计与跟踪，而每采样时刻用编码器更新提升状态估计更影响跟踪精度。
papers.abstract_en: Predictive accuracy alone does not ensure that data-driven Koopman representations are suitable for output-feedback control. This paper develops a continuous-time framework for learning control-relevant Koopman representations using only measured input-output trajectories. A causal encoder constructs the lifted state from a finite input-output window, and an additive lifted model is identified by integral regression. We distinguish observability, input-map compatibility, controllability, and data informativity. We characterize compatibility with a constant lifted input matrix, quantify input-map mismatch, and, under exact lifting assumptions, relate iterated Lie brackets to the controllable subspace of the lifted realization. A covariance-normalized finite-horizon observability criterion is optimized subject to separate bounds on output-prediction and temporal-consistency errors. Under the stated exactness and observability assumptions, the encoded lifted state depends only on the current nonlinear state. For approximate representations, we bound the difference between encodings of distinct past trajectories ending at the same state. An exactly liftable controlled system provides analytical ground truth, while a controlled Duffing oscillator illustrates the approximate setting, for which an informative exact additive lifting on an open set is shown to be impossible. On the exact benchmark, encoder initialization determines whether the learned representation recovers the analytical lift. In the reported Duffing experiments, observability promotion improves nominal Gramian measures without improving observer-based estimation or tracking, while updating the lifted-state estimate through the encoder at every sampling instant has a larger effect on tracking accuracy.

papers.title_en: PruneNAS: Constraint Aware Neural Architecture Search based Pruning
papers.authors: Sudhakar Sah, Nikhil Chhabra, Honnesh Rohmetra, Andy Li
papers.evidence: 结合结构化剪枝的神经网络架构搜索以降低搜索成本
papers.tldr: NAS性能强但搜索成本高。PruneNAS将结构化剪枝融入NAS，通过多粒度剪枝预训练网络构建候选池，并用免训练重要性指标做全局优化选择。在严格资源约束下，搜索时间从数百GPU小时降至数分钟，ResNet-50上MACs近减半且精度较高，并在YOLO检测任务上展现泛化。该工作连接剪枝与NAS，为资源受限部署提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks, but its high computational cost remains a major barrier. We introduce PruneNAS, a novel framework that integrates structured pruning into NAS to efficiently explore high-performing architectures while leveraging pretrained models. Unlike conventional NAS methods that train each candidate from scratch, PruneNAS generates a candidate pool by pruning pretrained networks at multiple granularity levels and formulates the selection as a global optimization problem using training-free importance metrics. This approach enables rapid evaluation of candidate architectures under strict resource constraints, dramatically reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to mere minutes. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PruneNAS discovers compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost (MACs) of prior methods on ResNet-50, while also showing strong generalization on object detection tasks with YOLO. Our method bridges structured pruning and NAS, offering a practical solution for resource-constrained model deployment.

papers.title_en: Driving the Style: Velocity-Conditioned Whole-Body Control from Motion Demonstrations
papers.authors: Murad Dawood, Oezge Drama Berkenkamp, Antonio Gonzales Marin, Nutan Chen
papers.evidence: 基于运动示范的humanoid全身控制策略
papers.tldr: 人形机器人模仿动捕风格常受限于对抗模仿难上硬件、全身跟踪依赖未来参考轨迹且泛化差。作者仅用全身跟踪奖励训练策略，将actor限制为紧凑运动指令与机器人观测，参考动作只监督奖励和特权critic，无需教师蒸馏。仅用单条随机行走动作训练，在留出动作速度指令下仿真成功率至少98%，Unitree G1全部试验完成；留出慢走时全身跟踪仅2%、指令蒸馏56%且实机失败。该方法把演示风格编码进速度条件策略，兼顾实机部署与风格覆盖。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving human-like behavior on humanoid robots has advanced rapidly by leveraging motion-capture demonstrations rather than hand-crafted cost functions. Adversarial imitation supplies a style signal that lets a policy fulfill a task while adhering to a desired style, but is difficult to transfer to hardware. Whole-body tracking through reinforcement learning instead deploys reliably and imitates demonstrations faithfully, but the resulting policies are conditioned on the future reference, so they require a reference trajectory at runtime and can fail when the motion differs from the training data. We train a humanoid policy directly with whole-body tracking rewards while restricting its actor to compact locomotion commands and robot observations. Reference motion supervises the reward and privileged critic, without supplying reference joint trajectories to the actor or requiring teacher distillation. The demonstrated style is thereby encoded in the policy through the tracking reward, so the robot reproduces the whole-body style under commanded velocities. Trained on a single random-walk motion and commanded with velocity profiles from held-out motions, our policy reaches at least 98\% success in simulation and completes every trial on the Unitree G1. On held-out slow walking, whole-body tracking drops to 2\% success and command-conditioned distillation to 56\%, and both fail on the real robot. On the trained motions, the joint position error of our policy stays within 8\% of whole-body tracking, and it has a higher style coverage than adversarial motion priors (AMP), which fell on the real robot without a safety crane.

papers.title_en: Koopman Temporal Logic and Model Predictive Control of Nonlinear Systems: A Demonstration in AC-DC Power Conversion
papers.authors: Shun Hirose, Shiu Mochiyama, Yoshihiko Susuki
papers.evidence: 用于非线性系统控制的Koopman算子理论
papers.tldr: 针对非线性系统难以进行形式化验证与控制的问题，论文提出一种新的Koopman时序逻辑KTL，利用Koopman算子理论为非线性动力学提供可验证、可控制的数学基础。文中在回顾信号时序逻辑后，给出KTL的语法、布尔语义和定量语义，并构建由KTL控制规范描述的模型预测控制MPC问题。最后将所提MPC公式应用于AC-DC功率变换的可靠设计，评估其有效性与计算效率。结果表明该方法能够支撑非线性系统形式化控制，并具有较好的计算表现。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel temporal logic, which we call Koopman Temporal Logic (KTL), towards a formal method in which Koopman operator theory provides a mathematical way to verify and control systems with nonlinear dynamics. We first review signal temporal logic and then introduce KTL, including its syntax, Boolean semantics, and quantitative semantics. Next, we propose a formulation of Model Predictive Control (MPC) from a control specification described by KTL. Effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed MPC formulation are evaluated by applying it to a reliable design of AC-DC power conversion.

papers.title_en: First-Order Model-Free Policy Gradient for Undiscounted LQR with Global Optimality and Convergence Guarantees
papers.authors: Vipul K Sharma, S Sivaranjani
papers.evidence: 面向LQR的无模型策略梯度，融合最优控制与强化学习
papers.tldr: 针对无折扣无限时域LQR缺乏模型无关一阶策略梯度全局保证的问题，作者构造以LQR增益参数化的随机包装策略类，在确定性线性控制律周围实现探索。其分析探索引起的无限时域附加代价，并建立弱梯度支配条件刻画探索下的全局最优性。随后仅用采样轨迹构造无模型一阶PG算法，无需辨识动力学或近似值函数，并给出有限时间收敛与近全局最优所需样本量保证。
papers.abstract_en: We provide a first-order model-free policy gradient (PG) framework for learning undiscounted infinite-horizon linear quadratic regulator (LQR) policies with global optimality and convergence guarantees. We first construct a stochastic wrapper policy class parameterized by the LQR gain to enable exploration around a deterministic linear control law. We analyze the additional cost induced by exploration over infinite-horizon, and establish a weak gradient dominance condition that characterizes global optimality under exploration. We then construct a model-free first-order PG algorithm using sampled trajectory information, without identifying the dynamics or approximating a value function. Finally, we establish finite-time convergence guarantees, providing the sufficient number of samples required for near-global optimality with our proposed PG algorithms.

papers.title_en: Sample-Efficient Model Predictive Control via Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Jiarui Wang, Sina Sharifi, Mahyar Fazlyab
papers.evidence: 通过PPO连接策略优化与采样型模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 采样型MPC需反复轨迹仿真，计算开销大。本文从KL正则化分布轨迹优化出发，基于带符号指数优势函数推导精确性能差恒等式，提出PPO-MPPI与SPO-MPPI，将PPO近端更新用于采样型MPC，复用已评估轨迹进行多次优化而无需额外前向仿真。理论上给出种群级单调改进保证，并证明固定协方差高斯采样下PPO-MPPI收敛到一阶驻点。四足与四旋翼跟踪实验显示，方法以显著更低计算成本取得有竞争力性能，连接了策略优化与采样型MPC并提升样本效率。
papers.abstract_en: Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) enables real-time control of complex nonlinear systems but often incurs substantial computational costs due to repeated trajectory simulations. In this paper, we bridge policy optimization in reinforcement learning and sampling-based MPC to improve computational efficiency through sample reuse. Starting from a KL-regularized distributional formulation of trajectory optimization, we derive an exact performance-difference identity based on a signed exponential advantage function. This identity motivates two algorithms, PPO-MPPI and SPO-MPPI, which adapt proximal policy optimization techniques to sampling-based MPC, enabling multiple optimization updates using previously evaluated trajectories without additional forward simulations. We establish population-level monotonic improvement guarantees for both methods and prove convergence to first-order stationarity for PPO-MPPI under fixed-covariance Gaussian sampling distributions. Experiments on quadruped velocity tracking and quadrotor path tracking demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve competitive control performance at substantially lower computational cost than multi-stage sampling approaches. Our results establish a principled connection between policy optimization and sampling-based MPC and highlight the potential of trajectory reuse for sample-efficient predictive control.

papers.title_en: SemPhys: Semantic-Physical Co-Learning for Humanoid Motion Generation via Differentiable World Models
papers.authors: Zejian Kang, Yeqiang Wang, Zekai Chen, Boyang Shen, Mingyu Ma, Bingqian Wu, Fan Zhou, Jianjie Zhang, Chentao Shen, Wentao Yang, Rui Qian, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 基于可微世界模型与语义反馈的人形机器人运动生成
papers.tldr: 自然人语言可驱使人形机器人全身运动，但常用“生成运动学参考+跟踪控制器”流程中，控制器为保持平衡和满足接触约束会偏离参考，从而改变动作语义。SemPhys 将语义对齐直接评估在机器人实际执行的完整轨迹上：用可微分世界模型与固定跟踪控制器预测执行片段，插入原轨迹后按指令打分并反向传播，同时用配对锚定损失稳定训练。在 BONES-SEED 上，它较好保持参考到执行的指令检索精度，并在执行动作上取得最高检索精度。
papers.abstract_en: In human-robot collaboration, natural language lets people direct a humanoid's whole-body movements without programming joint trajectories. A common approach generates a kinematic reference from an instruction and relies on a tracking controller to execute it. However, as the controller maintains balance under contact constraints, the executed motion can depart from the reference in ways that change the action it conveys. Our central insight is that semantic alignment must be evaluated directly on the complete motion the robot physically executes. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{SemPhys}, a framework that trains motion generators using semantic feedback from simulated executions. A differentiable world model and a fixed tracking controller predict a short segment of a recorded execution. SemPhys inserts this prediction at its original position, scores the complete trajectory against the instruction, and backpropagates through the predicted segment. A paired anchoring loss stabilizes adaptation by keeping each generated reference close to its counterpart from the initial generator. On BONES-SEED, SemPhys largely preserves instruction retrieval accuracy from reference to execution and achieves the highest retrieval accuracy on executed motions among the evaluated methods.

papers.title_en: Approximate Dynamic Programming with Basis Function Learning
papers.authors: Mohammadreza Fathi, Chi-Guhn Lee
papers.evidence: 基于近似线性规划与贝尔曼算子的值函数近似
papers.tldr: 在MDP值函数近似中，传统基函数依赖预定义、随机生成或特定结构，精度受限且缺乏改进机制。本文在近似线性规划框架下，反复对当前值估计应用Bellman算子，从模型学习基函数，提出BOBF方法，并给出SBOBF收缩版本。理论证明每个学习到的基函数都能可量化地改进近似，方法收敛到最优值函数；大规模场景下结合约束采样得到HBOBF与SHBOBF。易腐库存和排队控制实验表明，该方法显著优于现有方法，为自适应值函数近似提供了有效途径。
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a novel approach for approximating the value function in Markov decision processes (MDPs). Our approach is grounded in the approximate linear programming (ALP) framework, wherein basis functions (BFs) play an important role. Traditionally, BFs have been pre-defined, randomly generated, or restricted to specific structures, which both limits the accuracy that can be achieved and leaves no mechanism for improving a given approximation. We instead learn BFs from the model itself, by repeatedly applying the Bellman operator to the current value estimate. We introduce the Bellman operator basis function (BOBF) learning method, and prove that each learned BF improves the approximation by a quantifiable amount and that the method converges to the optimal value function. Its shrunken counterpart (SBOBF) retains this guarantee while capping the number of BFs, and therefore the computational effort per iteration. For large-scale problems, where the number of constraints is prohibitive, we develop hybrid variants (HBOBF and SHBOBF) that combine constraint sampling with BF learning, and we show that the improvement and finite-termination guarantees are preserved under explicitly stated conditions. Numerical experiments on (continuous) perishable inventory and queueing control problems demonstrate that our BF learning techniques significantly outperform existing methods in the literature.

papers.title_en: Algorithm Distillation for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Minjae Kwon, Amir Moeini, Shangtong Zhang, Lu Feng
papers.evidence: 在预算内保持代价的安全上下文强化学习
papers.tldr: Safe ICRL要求固定参数策略在交互历史中适应未见约束任务并控制成本，但Safe AD此前在部分基准出现适应失败。作者先用两阶段预算感知教师蒸馏学习历史，动态预算提升探索熵；再提出A-Lag，在测试时按预测成本重加权动作并用观测成本更新拉格朗日乘子。实验显示A-Lag在五个环境中平均回合成本均低于Safe AD，但四个环境最终回报更低。该工作重新审视Safe AD的训练与测试调整，揭示成本与回报的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (Safe ICRL) asks a policy with fixed parameters to improve on an unseen constrained task from its interaction history while aiming to keep its cost within a budget. Prior work studied Safe ICRL on five benchmarks in three families: a grid world with a hidden goal and obstacles (DarkRoom), continuous navigation where goals and hazards stay invisible until reached (PointGoal, CarGoal), and locomotion with a hidden velocity limit (HalfCheetah, Ant). Safe Algorithm Distillation (Safe AD), trained on the learning histories of a safe RL algorithm, has shown adaptation failures in prior evaluations. For example, in the locomotion tasks its return stays below zero, and it rarely reaches the goal in CarGoal. We revisit two parts of Safe AD. First, we distill a budget-aware teacher with two phases. It searches for the hidden task, exploring more when more budget remains. After its first reward or cost, an expert policy exploits the task within the remaining budget. We collect the teacher's histories under fixed or dynamic budgets. Dynamic budgets increase the occupancy entropy of the return and budget inputs in every environment, and at test time they improve return and lower cost in DarkRoom and HalfCheetah. Second, we propose A-Lag, a test-time adjustment that reweights the distilled policy's actions by their predicted cost, with an adaptive Lagrange multiplier that is updated from the costs observed. In our experiments, A-Lag had lower mean episode cost than Safe AD in all five environments, with lower mean final return in four.

papers.title_en: Bias-Reduced and Parallel Heavy-Tailed Stochastic Convex Optimization in $\ell_p$ Geometries
papers.authors: Zhengyun Nie, Anant Shyam, Brian Bullins
papers.evidence: 并行随机凸优化算法与收敛理论
papers.tldr: 随机凸优化在重尾噪声下难以兼顾并行效率与ℓ_p几何结构，现有结果多局限于方差有界的欧氏设定。本文引入ℓ_p最优距离收敛（ODC_p）偏差缩减算法，结合多层蒙特卡洛与p-GREG梯度估计器，提出EpochDA和ℓ_p-AC-SA两种并行算法。在均匀凸等目标上，查询深度降至Õ(d^{p/(2p+2)}ε^{-p/(p+1)})，并在相应区间优于顺序重尾的O(ε^{-p})，还给出投影高效优化、复合最小化与近端点估计的速率。作者同时建立非光滑凸优化的维度相关自适应轮数下界，改进了既有结果，为ℓ_p重尾并行优化提供算法与下界支撑。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the fundamental problem of parallel stochastic convex optimization (SCO), whose aim is to approximately minimize a convex objective when given the ability to query a moment-bounded stochastic gradient oracle multiple times in parallel per round. Whereas most previous results have focused on the variance-bounded Euclidean ($\ell_2$-norm) setting, meaning the objective is Lipschitz with respect to the $\ell_2$-norm over an $\ell_2$-bounded feasible set in $\mathbb{R}^d$, in this work we study parallel SCO in $\ell_p$ settings for $2 \le p < \infty$ under a heavy-tailed noise model. We begin by introducing a new class of $\ell_p$-optimal-distance-convergence (ODC$_p$) algorithms, drawing on prior stochastic bias-reduced techniques [ACJ+21], which combine with multilevel Monte Carlo methods to efficiently estimate the optimum of uniformly convex objectives. As a consequence of our ODC$_p$ algorithms, we first establish rates for projection-efficient $\ell_p$-Lipschitz optimization, composite convex minimization, and efficient $\ell_p$-proximal point estimation. Combining our ODC$_p$ algorithms with a new $\ell_p$-generalized Gaussian-based stochastic gradient estimator ($p$-GREG), we provide two efficient $\ell_p$ parallel algorithms, EpochDA and $\ell_p$-AC-SA, which achieve optimization error $ε> 0$ with at most $\tilde{O}(d^{\frac{p}{2p + 2}} ε^{-\frac{p}{p + 1}})$ query depth, improving upon the sequential heavy-tailed stochastic query depth of $O(ε^{-p})$ for $ε\leq \tilde{O}(d^{-1/(2p)})$. We also establish dimension-dependent lower bounds of $Ω\bigl(\min\{ε^{-p},d^{p/(3p-2)}\}\bigr)$ adaptive rounds for nonsmooth convex optimization over a subset of the unit $\ell_p$ ball. Our results improve upon the $Ω(\min\{ε^{-p},ε^{2/3}d^{1/3}\})$ bounds of [DG19], when adapted to the same feasible set.

papers.title_en: GP--RL--MPC: Uncertainty-Aware Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control with Gaussian Process Postdecision State-Value Functions
papers.authors: Jon Li, Jay H. Lee
papers.evidence: 将最优控制与强化学习结合的RL增强模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 针对有限预测时域下MPC难以计入远期代价的问题，提出GP-RL-MPC，用高斯过程学习价值评论家并作为终端惩罚。方法结合乐观近似策略迭代、软更新与可调风险系数，显式权衡GP认知不确定性，并用后决策状态离线处理随机扰动。在CSTR扰动场景中，合适风险系数与策略筛选使SSE较匹配基线MPC平均降低80.52%。该框架以数据高效方式提升不确定环境下MPC的长期性能与稳定性。
papers.abstract_en: We propose Gaussian Process Reinforcement Learning-Augmented Model Predictive Control (GP--RL--MPC), which uses a learned critic as the MPC terminal penalty to account for costs beyond the prediction horizon. Gaussian process regression (GPR) enables data-efficient critic learning from limited, noisy rollouts within optimistic approximate policy iteration (OAPI), with soft updates mitigating policy chattering. A tunable risk coefficient weights GP epistemic uncertainty in the terminal cost, regulating sensitivity to uncertain critic predictions. The postdecision state formulation shifts disturbance averaging offline to account for aleatoric uncertainty from the terminal transition onward. Under matching objectives and admissible actions, a one-step horizon recovers greedy value-space RL. After fitting GP hyperparameters by exact marginal likelihood, we construct a sparse deterministic training conditional (DTC) posterior using inducing points selected by pivoted Cholesky (PC), reducing online evaluation costs as the training dataset grows. In a continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) subject to exogenous disturbances, GP--RL--MPC with an appropriately selected risk coefficient and policy screening reduces the sum of squared errors (SSE) by an average of 80.52% relative to an otherwise matched baseline MPC across five random seeds (sample standard deviation: 3.48%).

papers.title_en: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.authors: Ting-Hsuan Chen, Siheng Zhao, Han Jiang, Qi Pan, Louison Lu, Jiaheng Luo, Henghui Bao, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 去中心化多humanoid全身运动操作，含强化学习后训练
papers.tldr: 多台人形机器人协作受限于全身物理耦合、长时程规划与跨机同步。Heave-Ho以低层多智能体后训练适配物理耦合交互，高层结合视觉语言规划与语音主从协调，实现无网络通信的去中心化执行。两机训练可扩展至十机并泛化异构团队，在HH-Bench 12项任务上优于基线。该工作提出基准并真机验证长时程多 humanoid 协作。
papers.abstract_en: Collaboration promises to extend humanoid capabilities beyond what individual robots can achieve. However, realizing this potential requires coordinated whole-body interactions, coherent long-horizon planning, and precise synchronization across robots. We introduce Heave-Ho, a decentralized framework for long-horizon collaborative multi-humanoid loco-manipulation. At the low level, we develop a multi-agent post-training framework that adapts a humanoid foundation tracking model to physically coupled interactions between humanoids, enabling coordinated decentralized control from local observations alone. At the high level, we train a vision-language planner and design a speech-based leader-follower coordination mechanism to synchronize decentralized execution without network communication. Trained with two identical humanoids, our system scales to teams of up to ten robots and generalizes to heterogeneous teams without retraining. To benchmark these capabilities, we introduce HH-Bench, comprising 12 tasks involving teams of 2 to 10 humanoids, including heterogeneous teams. Systematic evaluations show that Heave-Ho consistently outperforms baseline methods, while real-world experiments demonstrate robust decentralized collaboration across challenging tasks.

papers.title_en: Robust Actor-Critic Learning under Transport and Divergence Uncertainty
papers.authors: Kunqi Huang, Lican Kang, Hongrui Shu, Jincheng Ying
papers.evidence: 转移不确定集下的鲁棒演员-评论家
papers.tldr: 针对连续状态动作、标称转移未知的鲁棒MDP，现有actor-critic难以同时处理转移不确定性与函数估计、动作生成误差。论文用Wasserstein、全变差、KL或卡方构造转移不确定集，先以条件扩散模型拟合离线转移，再以共享目标minimax估计鲁棒动作价值，并通过指数加权得分匹配更新生成式actor。理论给出critic、条件动作分布与鲁棒回报的有限样本界，区分估计误差、标称模型不确定性与策略正则化，并刻画四种鲁棒半径的影响。
papers.abstract_en: Learning reliable control policies requires accounting for uncertainty in transition dynamics and errors introduced by function estimation and action generation. We develop an actor--critic method for discounted robust Markov decision processes with continuous states and actions and an unknown nominal transition law. We consider transition uncertainty sets defined by Wasserstein distance, total variation, Kullback--Leibler divergence, or Pearson chi-square divergence. A conditional diffusion model is fitted once to offline transitions. At each subsequent iteration, we estimate the robust action-value function from current-policy observations using a shared-target minimax criterion, then update a generative actor through exponentially weighted score matching. Regularization preserves exploration and provides the density regularity needed for conditional distribution estimation. Under coverage and regularity conditions, we establish finite-sample bounds for critic estimation, the learned conditional action law, and the robust return of the implemented policy. The bounds distinguish critic estimation error, uncertainty in the nominal transition model, and policy regularization, and characterize how the four robustness radii affect the resulting guarantees.

papers.title_en: Joint Learning of Control Lyapunov Functions and Controllers via Stable-by-Design Surrogates
papers.authors: Patricia Pauli, Matthieu Barreau
papers.evidence: 联合学习控制李雅普诺夫函数与稳定控制器
papers.tldr: 针对神经网络控制Lyapunov函数训练与验证计算开销大的问题，提出联合学习CLF与稳定控制器的框架。方法用PLNets参数化非凸正定CLF候选，并构造按设计满足Lyapunov下降条件的闭环动力学代理，控制器由线性反馈与类Sontag高阶修正组成。理论给出局部与全局稳定性保证，数值算例验证有效性。该工作无需已知CLF即可同时学习CLF与控制器，降低验证负担并提升设计可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Training and verifying neural network-based control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) can be computationally demanding. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that jointly learns a CLF and a stabilizing controller using structured neural networks and a projection-based parameterization. Specifically, we employ Polyak-Lojasiewicz networks (PLNets), which parameterize nonconvex, positive-definite CLF candidates, and construct a stable-by-design surrogate of the closed-loop dynamics that satisfies the Lyapunov decrease condition by construction. The controller combines linear state feedback with a higher-order correction term resembling Sontag's universal formula and is trained to align the resulting closed-loop dynamics with the stable-by-design surrogate. Unlike classical approaches based on Sontag's formula, our framework does not require a known CLF; instead, it learns the CLF and controller simultaneously. We establish local and global stability guarantees for the learned controller and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach through numerical examples.

papers.title_en: Federated TD Learning in Heterogeneous Environments with Average Rewards: A Two-timescale Approach with Polyak-Ruppert Averaging
papers.authors: Ankur Naskar, Gugan Thoppe, Abbasali Koochakzadeh, Vijay Gupta
papers.evidence: 采用两时间尺度步长与Polyak-Ruppert平均的TD学习收敛分析，属于值函数学习范畴
papers.tldr: 联邦强化学习可利用多边缘设备并行加速训练，但异构环境下已有最优线性加速依赖未知模型参数选择步长，且仅适用于折扣设定。本文研究平均奖励下的异构联邦TD学习，将单时间尺度方法改为结合迭代平均的双时间尺度变体。理论上给出有限时间界，并证明采用与动态无关的通用步长仍可达到最优收敛速率和线性加速。该结果将异构联邦强化学习的理论保证扩展到持续控制任务，并可推广到同构或折扣情形。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) provides a promising way to speedup training in reinforcement learning when one has access to multiple edge devices that can operate in parallel. Recently, it has been shown that even when these edge devices have access to different dynamic models---such as cars or robots with differing system configurations---an optimal convergence rate that has a linear speedup proportional to the number of devices is achievable. However, this result requires that the algorithm's stepsize be chosen in a manner that depends on the unknown model parameters. Also, it applies only to a discounted setting, which has been argued to fit episodic tasks better than continuing control tasks. In this paper, we obtain finite-time bounds for heterogeneous FRL with average rewards. We show that optimal convergence rate and linear speedup are achievable even with a universal stepsize choice, independent of the underlying dynamics. To achieve our result, we modify the existing one-timescale FRL method to a novel two-timescale variant that additionally incorporates iterate averaging. We remark that this idea also extends to other settings already studied in the literature, such as the homogeneous FRL or the heterogeneous case with a discounted cost function.

papers.title_en: Body Schema Policy: Body as the Vision-Action Interface for Efficient Robot Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Lechen Zhang, Chenyuan Chen, Muxin Zhou, Zewen He, Yoshihiko Nakamura
papers.evidence: 具身体图式归纳偏置的全身loco-manipulation策略
papers.tldr: 现有全身移动操作策略依赖大规模参数与任务微调，效率低。BSP 将身体图式引入视觉-动作接口：在运动学树上组织关节/连杆 token，用螺旋运动传递特征，并由身体部位查询自身视觉证据来条件化动作去噪。它在九个 Unitree G1 仿真任务上以仅 1/75 参数匹配 Ψ0，成功率接近 Diffusion Policy 两倍，并迁移到真实 G1 与 Fetch。该工作展示了结构化身体先验可显著提升策略效率与泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Currently, robots can learn whole-body loco-manipulation through scale: the strongest policies have billions of parameters and still need task-specific fine-tuning. Humans have limited processing capacity, yet learn and act efficiently through a body schema that organizes what they see and how they move. We introduce Body Schema Policy (BSP), an imitation learning policy that builds such a schema into the vision-action interface. Its latent body schema places joint and link tokens on the robot's kinematic tree, where learned screw motions carry features between links. Through body-queried vision, each body part retrieves its own visual evidence, which conditions the denoising of its actions. With this inductive bias, BSP returns an action chunk faster than any policy we compare. Compact, body-specific visual readouts also emerge without spatial supervision: manipulation commands depend strongly on task objects, while locomotion commands respond more broadly to the scene. On nine simulated Unitree G1 whole-body tasks, BSP matches the $Ψ_0$ humanoid foundation model with $75\times$ fewer parameters and nearly doubles Diffusion Policy's success. The same holds on a real G1 and a Fetch mobile manipulator.

papers.title_en: Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Balance on Dynamically Responsive Supports
papers.authors: Changyan Li, Guiyin Tian, Jing Xia, Shiyan Hu
papers.evidence: 受李雅普诺夫启发的机器人平衡稳定控制
papers.tldr: 传统平衡控制常假设支撑刚性静止，忽略身体校正会反向激发支撑运动，形成耦合控制难题。论文提出LISST学习框架，将持续平衡视为耦合调节问题，用短/长历史观测与物理监督学习机器人-支撑表征。该方法以Lyapunov启发准则在有限窗口评估校正进展，并通过可微模型滚动反传和特权蒸馏训练策略。真机实验显示其能在动态响应支撑上维持平衡并抑制残余振荡。
papers.abstract_en: Conventional balance formulations often assume a rigid, stationary support, decoupling body stabilization from support motion. This assumption becomes inadequate on mechanically responsive supports, creating a coupled control challenge: corrective body motions intended to restore equilibrium can also excite support motion. We formulate sustained balance as a coupled regulation problem that coordinates equilibrium restoration with suppression of motion induced by the robot's own corrections. We introduce LISST (Lyapunov-Inspired Sustained Stabilization), a learning framework that accounts for how earlier actions shape the conditions for subsequent corrections. It uses recent observations to support immediate adjustments and longer histories to characterize persistent motion, with physical supervision relating the learned representation to robot-support behavior. To evaluate corrective actions, LISST uses coupled dynamics to assess both imbalance and the direction of motion. A Lyapunov-inspired criterion measures progress over finite windows, accommodating the transients required to restore balance. This physical evaluation guides joint-level policy learning through backpropagation through differentiable model rollouts. Privileged guidance focuses training on difficult states reached by the deployment policy and is transferred through distillation. The resulting policy operates using only onboard proprioception. Real-world experiments demonstrate that LISST maintains balance while limiting residual oscillations during continuous interaction with a dynamically responsive support. Video: youtu.be/iGHU7S4wPyw.
